questions.text: CSS 2018, 2023, 2024 · Pair: Faint / Feint — Which meaning fits “Faint”?

options.A: To scatter or plant seeds; (noun) a female pig
options.B: To fire a weapon; a new growth from a plant
options.C: Weak, barely perceptible; or to lose consciousness briefly
options.D: A deceptive movement meant to mislead an opponent

questions.explanation:
Faint: Weak, barely perceptible; or to lose consciousness briefly. Sentence: "After standing for hours in the heat, the old man felt faint and sat down; the music was so faint we could barely hear it."
Feint: A pretended attack or movement meant to deceive an opponent. Sentence: "The boxer made a feint with his left hand and then struck with his right."
Source: CSS 2018, 2023, 2024 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2023 · Pair: Antic / Antique — Which meaning fits “Antic”?

options.A: A foolish, grotesque or funny act (usually plural: antics)
options.C: Angry (archaic/literary adjective, used after a verb)
options.D: Lasting for a very short time

questions.explanation:
Antic: A foolish, grotesque or funny act (usually plural: antics). Sentence: "The children laughed at the clown's antics as he tripped over his own giant shoes."
Antique: An old object valued for its age and craftsmanship; very old. Sentence: "The antique clock, made in 1820, sold at auction for a fortune."
Source: CSS 2023 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2023 · Pair: Draught / Drought — Which meaning fits “Draught”?

options.A: A long period of no rain
options.B: A current of cool air in a room; (British) a drink or a game piece
options.C: Something that completes or enhances something else; to go well with
options.D: A person believed to be able to see the future; a prophet

questions.explanation:
Draught: A current of cool air in a room; (British) a drink or a game piece. Sentence: "Close the window; there is a cold draught blowing on the baby."
Drought: A long period of abnormally low rainfall causing water shortage. Sentence: "The drought in Tharparkar dried up the wells and killed the livestock."
Source: CSS 2023 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2023 · Pair: Quaint / Queer — Which meaning fits “Quaint”?

options.B: A deep, wide ditch, usually filled with water, around a castle or fort
options.C: Lasting for a very short time

questions.explanation:
Quaint: Attractively unusual or old-fashioned. Sentence: "The tourists loved the quaint village with its wooden houses and cobbled lanes."
Queer: (Traditional sense) strange, odd or peculiar; today also used as an identity term. Sentence: "There was a queer silence in the house, as if something had gone wrong."

questions.text: CSS 2023 · Pair: Momentary / Momentous — Which meaning fits “Momentary”?

options.A: A foolish, grotesque or funny act (usually plural: antics)
options.B: A hidden store of money or valuables; to collect and hide
options.C: Lasting for a very short time

questions.explanation:
Momentary: Lasting for a very short time. Sentence: "There was a momentary flicker of the lights, and then the power returned."
Momentous: Of great importance or significance. Sentence: "The creation of Pakistan in 1947 was a momentous event in the history of South Asia."
Source: CSS 2023 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2023 · Pair: Compliment / Complement — Which meaning fits “Compliment”?

options.A: A polite expression of praise or admiration
options.B: A person who rides the leading near-side horse of a team drawing a carriage
options.C: Something that completes or goes well with another
options.D: A group of attendants or followers accompanying an important person

questions.explanation:
Compliment: A polite expression of praise or admiration. Sentence: "The teacher paid her a compliment on her neat handwriting."
Complement: Something that completes or enhances something else; to go well with. Sentence: "A green chutney is the perfect complement to hot samosas."
Source: CSS 2023 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2023 · Pair: Eminent / Imminent — Which meaning fits “Eminent”?

options.A: An electrical component that opposes the flow of current
options.C: To cut wool or hair with large blades; to break under strain
options.D: Famous and respected within a field; distinguished

questions.explanation:
Eminent: Famous and respected within a field; distinguished. Sentence: "Dr Abdus Salam was an eminent physicist who won the Nobel Prize."
Imminent: About to happen; very near in time. Sentence: "Dark clouds and strong winds warned that a storm was imminent."
Source: CSS 2023 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2023 · Pair: Immigrant / Emigrant — Which meaning fits “Immigrant”?

options.A: A person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country
options.B: A large crowd of people, often disorderly or threatening
options.C: A person who leaves their own country to settle abroad
options.D: About to happen; very near in time

questions.explanation:
Immigrant: A person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country. Sentence: "As an immigrant in Canada, Ahmed had to learn new customs and find a new job."
Emigrant: A person who leaves their own country to settle in another. Sentence: "Every year thousands of emigrants leave Pakistan for the Gulf in search of work."
Source: CSS 2023 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).
